correctness.rationale: For stationary W_h=X/ell, the independent-Laplace product M_h(t)=product_{j>=0}(1-t^2 exp(-hj))^{-1} gives K_h=Li_2(t^2)/h-(1/2)log(1-t^2)+O(h), with two derivative controls on compact t subintervals. Positive curvature and Lambda prime tending to infinity define a unique saddle t_y. The tilted Laplace factors admit an integrable Fourier majorant from the first floor(1/h) factors, proving a uniform local density limit of order sqrt(h), not just an ordinary CLT. Tilting the half-line integral and applying the endpoint Euler-Maclaurin multiplier establishes the exact stated sqrt(h)/[t_y sqrt(2pi(1-t_y^2)Lambda''(t_y))] prefactor for each fixed y>0 uniformly on positive compact sets. Small-y and large-y expansions follow by series and saddle inversion; no joint endpoint uniformity. These analytic steps were read from the actual RESULT.md; stored 48 numerical checks are supporting diagnostics only.

originality.rationale: An independently published 2026-11-08 RESULT.md, read in full, gives the identical stationary sharp dilogarithmic tail and full boundary prefactor under a reparameterization. Set epsilon=h/2, t=ell theta, and prior threshold y_prior=ell*y/2. Its exponent becomes I(y)/h. Therefore the whole submitted conclusion (including the supposedly distinguishing prefactor) is already covered. Relative same-day posting order is unknown, but extant scientific coverage is decisive for this review. Earlier Nov 2 papers cover only the rate, not the prefactor.
